name: Guest books a pay-at-hotel room with breakfast from search to confirmation e-mail
objective: Verify the whole guest journey across all six services: search, hotel details, offers, cart, extra, payment summary, reservation and confirmation e-mail.
precondition: The six hotel services are running with their seeded catalogue (reset before the case).
steps: Search NYC for the standard stay
Create a cart and add breakfast
testData: search.destination=NYC; selection.ratePlanCode=FLEX; extras.code=BREAKFAST; extras.quantity=1; every other booking attribute from the hotel data dictionary examples
expected: HTTP 201 CONFIRMED with a confirmation number; e-mail generated with the same number and total; cart total = payment summary total = booked total

name: Guest books a prepaid non-refundable room in Paris and pays now
objective: Verify the prepaid journey: the payment summary asks for the full amount now and the booking confirms.
precondition: The six hotel services are running with their seeded catalogue (reset before the case).
steps: Create a cart for the prepaid rate
testData: search.destination=PAR; selection.hotelId=H-PAR-001; selection.roomCode=STD-K; selection.ratePlanCode=SAVER; every other booking attribute from the hotel data dictionary examples
expected: Payment summary pay-now = total; HTTP 201 CONFIRMED

name: A sold-out hotel is shown as unavailable and cannot be put in a cart
objective: Verify that a hotel with no rooms left is not offered as bookable and that trying to book it is refused.
precondition: The six hotel services are running with their seeded catalogue (reset before the case). Inventory of the chosen hotel is set to 0.
steps: Try to create a cart for that hotel
testData: selection.hotelId=H-NYC-001; every other booking attribute from the hotel data dictionary examples
expected: Result shows availability SOLD_OUT, bookable false, no starting price; cart creation returns HTTP 409 ROOM_NO_LONGER_AVAILABLE

name: An unavailable extra is refused and the room still books
objective: Verify that an extra that cannot be sold is refused clearly while the room reservation still succeeds.
precondition: The six hotel services are running with their seeded catalogue (reset before the case). LATE_CHECKOUT is marked unavailable.
testData: extras.code=LATE_CHECKOUT; extras.quantity=1; every other booking attribute from the hotel data dictionary examples
expected: Adding the extra returns HTTP 422 EXTRA_NOT_AVAILABLE; reservation HTTP 201 CONFIRMED

name: A double-clicked Book button creates one reservation and one payment
objective: Verify that two simultaneous submissions with the same idempotency key produce one reservation and one authorisation.
precondition: The six hotel services are running with their seeded catalogue (reset before the case).
steps: Submit the reservation twice at the same time with one key
testData: request.idempotencyKeyPrefix=aqe-double; every other booking attribute from the hotel data dictionary examples
expected: Both responses name the same reservation; exactly one payment authorisation exists

name: The confirmation number can be looked up again after booking
objective: Verify the confirmation identifier is stored with the reservation and returned on later reads.
precondition: The six hotel services are running with their seeded catalogue (reset before the case).
steps: Read the reservation back by id
testData: Standard booking: every other booking attribute from the hotel data dictionary examples
expected: HTTP 201 with a 10-character HB… number; GET /api/reservations/{id} returns the same number and CONFIRMED

name: The guest sees the booking outcome and one confirmation e-mail is created
objective: Verify the outcome the guest sees and that exactly one confirmation e-mail request exists.
precondition: The six hotel services are running with their seeded catalogue (reset before the case).
steps: List the messages for the reservation
testData: Standard booking: every other booking attribute from the hotel data dictionary examples
expected: Outcome headline says the booking is confirmed; one CONFIRMATION message for the reservation

name: Guest books a flexible room, then cancels it free of charge more than 48 hours before check-in
objective: Verify the release 2.0 cancellation journey across search, cart, reservation and payment: the booking ends cancelled and the payment hold is voided.
precondition: The six hotel services are running with their seeded catalogue (reset before the case).
steps: Book a FLEX rate 30 days ahead
testData: selection.ratePlanCode=FLEX; every other booking attribute from the hotel data dictionary examples
expected: Booking HTTP 201 CONFIRMED; cancel HTTP 200 CANCELLED with payment VOIDED; the reservation stays CANCELLED

name: Guest books, cancels and receives exactly one confirmation and one cancellation e-mail
objective: Verify the release 2.0 cancellation journey across reservation and notification: the guest is told once about the booking and once about the cancellation.
precondition: The six hotel services are running with their seeded catalogue (reset before the case).
testData: selection.ratePlanCode=FLEX; every other booking attribute from the hotel data dictionary examples
expected: Booking CONFIRMED with its e-mail; cancel HTTP 200 CANCELLED; exactly one CONFIRMATION and one CANCELLATION message
